key.name: surface-treatment
key.description: One manual treatment for native shell and application surfaces. Until explicitly chosen, preserve the current system color scheme. Frost and Glass require live renderer support; unsupported applications stay opaque.

key.name: reduce-transparency
key.description: Use opaque surfaces for accessibility. Frost and Glass both fall back to Light without overwriting the chosen treatment.

key.name: home-apps
key.description: An empty list makes Home follow the canonical favorites order.

key.name: restore-app-state
key.summary: Restore supported applications across posture transitions

key.name: shelf-edge
key.summary: Screen edge that owns the Shelf

key.name: shelf-dock-anchor
key.summary: Dock anchor within the Shelf edge

key.name: shelf-actions-anchor
key.summary: Action island anchor within the Shelf edge

key.name: shelf-surface-mode
key.summary: Whether Shelf islands share one visual surface

key.name: shelf-edge-mode
key.summary: Whether the Shelf floats inside or protrudes from its edge

key.name: shelf-span-full
key.summary: Stretch the Dash along its selected monitor edge

key.name: shelf-float-ends
key.summary: Keep end gutters when the Dash spans its edge
key.description: Retained while spanning is disabled; has no effect until spanning is enabled.

key.name: shelf-padding
key.summary: Dash content padding and floating edge gaps
key.description: Logical pixels around each island's content and at floating screen edges. Icon spacing is independent.

key.name: shelf-material
key.description: Dark is production-ready. Light, Glass, and Frost are reserved contract values for later treatments.

key.name: shelf-actions-visible
key.summary: Show the Shelf action and status island

key.name: shelf-reserve-work-area
key.summary: Keep ordinary windows out of the Shelf region

key.name: shelf-auto-hide
key.description: Reserved for a future policy. The production v1 Shelf remains visible.

key.name: shelf-free-placement
key.summary: Allow islands anywhere along an edge
key.description: ADR-044. Off: an island goes beside another island or to an edge's start, center or end, and a stored free position is drawn at the nearest of those. On: islands may also sit at any position along an edge.

key.name: shelf-arrangement
key.summary: Where each group of Shelf islands is placed
key.description: ADR-044. Each entry is one group of attached islands: 'display' (s: '' follows the primary monitor, otherwise 'connector|vendor|product|serial'), 'edge' (s: top, bottom, left or right), 'anchor' (s: start, center, end or free), 'position' (d: 0.0 to 1.0, the group centre along the edge when anchor is free) and 'islands' (as: dock, live, media, well, quick-options, clock, notifications, in physical order). Empty means the default layout derived from shelf-edge, shelf-dock-anchor, shelf-actions-anchor and shelf-group-layout.

key.name: dock-folders
key.description: Folder URIs, in the order they are shown. Each one gets a tile after the applications, behind the Dash's divider, that opens the folder in place.

key.name: dock-folders-visible
key.summary: Show the pinned folders in the Dash
key.description: Off hides the folders rail without unpinning anything: the folders keep their places, their arrangements and their counts, and come back as they were.

key.name: dock-folders-separate
key.summary: Show the Dock folders as an island of their own
key.description: Off (the default): the folders are a part of the Dock, with the divider in front of them. On: they leave the Dock and become the 'folders' island, placed and moved like any other island.

key.name: dock-folders-views
key.summary: The arrangement each Dock folder opens in
key.description: Folder URI to 'stack' (a list) or 'grid' (an icon view). A folder with no entry opens as a Stack.

key.name: dock-folders-seen
key.summary: When each Dock folder was last opened
key.description: Folder URI to a Unix time. The tile's count is the files created since then, so opening a folder clears it. A file system that cannot report creation times shows no count.

key.name: dock-folders-detached
key.summary: A Dock folder left open away from the Dock
key.description: The folder broken out of the Dock when the session ended: 'uri' (s), 'x' and 'y' (i, its position) and 'monitors' (s, the display layout it was left on). It is reopened there only if that layout is still the one in use.

key.name: touchpad-app-switch
key.description: A three-finger swipe left or right moves to the next or the previous app, following your fingers and finishing when you let go. Off leaves three fingers sideways to the Shell.

key.name: touchpad-workspace-fingers
key.description: Four, so that three can switch app. Three gives the workspaces their old gesture back, and then apps have none.

key.name: touchpad-gesture-migration
key.summary: Whether the gesture defaults have been written once
key.description: Luma writes the gesture defaults a single time, so that a person who changes them afterwards keeps their choice when the defaults change again.
